The '''Lost Aqualish War Party's Cave''' was a cave located northwest of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Dearic/Legends|Dearic]] on the planet [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. It was used by the [[Lost Aqualish]].

==History==
{{Quote|This is where you can find the so-called "Lost Aqualish War Party". Go out there and make sure they get lost permanently. They're just bad for business.|A commoner, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AC" />}}
[[File:Lost_Aqualish_soldiers.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Lost Aqualish soldiers in the cave.]]
The cave was the base of operations of the [[Lost Aqualish]],<ref name="SWG:LAWPC" /> a group of isolationist [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] whose ancestors were secretly positioned on Talus during the [[Corellian/Aqualish war|Aqualish–Corellian War]] centuries prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], and forgotten when the war ended.<ref name="CDHZ">{{SonyCite|url=players/guides.vm?id=80113|text=CorSec Database H-Z|int=CorSec Database H-Z}}</ref> The Aqualish war party discovered the cave in the wilderness of Talus and took up permanent residence when they realized that it was the perfect staging ground for their raids.<ref name="SWG:LAWPC" /> Over the centuries, the Aqualish had managed to keep their base hidden from everyone, especially the human settlers on Talus. The Lost Aqualish were still living in the cave during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], ready to take the fight against the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] when the conflict would begin anew.<ref name="CDHZ" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] in [[Nashal]] requested a spacer to attack the cave and eliminate as much Aqualish warriors as possible.<ref name="SWG:AC" />

The same year, a spacer visited the cave and collected a sinew wrapped knife.<ref name="SWG:RRWMII">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Rare Rifle Weapons Mark II}}</ref>
